{% block title %} Instructions: Part 2 {% endblock %} {% block content %}

In Part 2, you are grouped with the same 3 players as in Part 1.

In Part 2, each of you will be credited with additional 100 Talers. And each of you will independently make a decision on changing the endowments of these additional 100 Talers for each player in your group privately and anonymously.

For each other player in your group you can decide to:

1) Leave a player's endowment of 100 Talers unchanged. This option is costless.

2) Increase a player's endowment of 100 Talers by 10, 20, or 30 Talers. This will cost you a fixed amount of 1 Taler. In other words, each time you choose to increase someone’s endowment by 10, 20, or 30 Talers, your endowment will decrease by 1 Taler.

3) Decrease a player's endowment of 100 Talers by 10, 20, or 30 Talers. This will bring you a fixed amount of 1 Taler. In other words, each time you choose to decrease someone’s endowment by 10, 20, or 30 Talers, your endowment will increase by 1 Taler.

Each of 3 other players in your group will decide on changing the endowments of their group mates (including yourself) in the same manner.

This decision will be one shot and not visible to other players. You will decide on changing the endowments of the 3 other players in your group on one page, as shown in the example below.

Example

Let's assume that a player's role is Player Orange. Player Orange decides to decrease the endowment of Player Purple by 30 Talers (which gives her 1 Taler), not to change the endowment of Player Pink, and to increase the endowment of Player Turquoise by 30 Talers (which costs 1 Taler). Player Orange makes decisions by clicking the corresponding widgets as shown in the picture above.

On the other hand, let's assume that Player Purple decides to decrease the endowment of Player Orange by 20 Talers, Player Pink decides to increase the endowment of Player Orange by 10 Talers, and Player Turquoise decides not to change the endowment of Player Orange.

When all players in the group make their decisions, the endowment of Player Orange will be equal to 90 Talers:

100 + (1 + 0 - 1) + (- 20 + 10 + 0) = 90 Talers.

You will have 1 minute to decide on the endowments of 3 other players in your group. You will see the countdown at the top of the page. All players in your group will make decisions simultaneously, and none of you will know with certainty who made which decision regarding their endowment.

When Part 2 is finished, you will be informed about your payment: your final payment will be the sum of 100 Talers for performing the task in Part 1, and the amount which you will receive in Part 2 based on the decisions of 3 other players in your group, and your own decisions.

Now, please click the "Continue" button to proceed with Part 2 of the experiment.
